$comment: Append-only log of where each floating pointer branch has pointed. THIS FILE IS THE WHOLE POINT: a force-pushed branch has no history, so without an append-only record there is no way to prove a submission tested an agreed base. A tag pins a commit forever; a floating branch does not. Written by the EVerest CI job that moves the pointers; never edited by hand, never reordered, entries never removed.

testing/main.description: Latest commit on main that EVerest CI considers the agreed base to test against. Force-pushed forward; never rewound.

testing/stable-2026.02.description: Same, for the 2026.02 maintenance line. NOTE the name: it deliberately does NOT live under stable/, because stable/2026.02 already exists as a real protected branch that receives backports.
